scope: Public storage, slip-rental and customer-information pages.

metrics.label: Published wet slips / dry-stack spaces
metrics.context: Company-reported covered wet slips and dry-stack spaces; capacity not independently verified.

metrics.label: Stated inquiry response window
metrics.context: Website promise, not a measured response time.

observations.title: Distinguish an inquiry from a reservation
observations.observed: Several “Reserve” and “Check Availability” links lead to a slip inquiry section whose text promises a team response within 24 hours. The form includes slip type, boat length and a waitlist option.
observations.improvement: Use "Request availability" where confirmation is needed, and state when a slip is reserved. Test carrying the chosen slip type into the inquiry.

observations.title: Show when availability was last checked
observations.observed: The slip page says availability is updated weekly and uses limited-availability messaging, but its reviewed availability section does not display a dated, slip-by-slip status.
observations.improvement: Test a last-updated date and available/inquire/waitlist status by slip type or size. Link social availability posts to that same reference page.

sources.label: Slip rentals / availability and inquiry wording

limitations: Capacity and response commitments are website-reported. Actual inventory, response performance and portal functionality were not tested.
Public website review only. No forms submitted or mobile-usability, conversion, speed or internal-system tests performed.
